product_metadata.title: Queens of Christmas Gold and Silver 100' Metallic Tinsel Garland
description: This highly festive garland is the perfect way to add some much needed elegance and flare to your holiday decor. Stretching an exceptionally long 100', this garland can be used in commercial areas such as shopping malls and parks as well as your home or office. It is 3" wide and comprised of 2-ply metallic silver colored tinsel. Works exceptionally well in lit areas, as the tinsel will reflect the light.

details.Care instructions: Store after use, Wipe with damp cloth
